2026-10-27 Italy

Rome Day 3

Breakfast

For breakfast we had panini, a croissant, coffee, hot chocolate, and crostatine alla frutta

The conference hotel

Made it to the conference hotel!

The food at the hotel was OK

An ancient road beneath the hotel

They have a road from 200 BC under the hotel!

The ancient road through a glass floor.

Castel Sant’Angelo

As part of the conference, we did a tour of Castel Sant’Angelo and the Vatican.

Everything was covered in marble that was later taken from here and reused in other buildings (thus the holes).
An old elevator mechanism was supported here
How it looked before
What it looks like now after the marble was stripped away and other damage occurred
Ancient coins
Playing dice and a container to roll them in!
Strainer found in Pompeii
Eggs found in Pompeii
View from the top
These are everywhere in Italy. The water is drinkable, and you can fill your bottle or just drink from it quite easily.

On to the Vatican

Vatican unlocked!
Consulates to the embassy! There were lots.

St. Peter’s Basilica

Dome (cupola) in St. Peter's Basilica!
Confession booths in many languages

Dinner at the hotel

Ending the day with more hotel food. Desserts make up for the quality (at least for Rachel).
